artifacts.summary: Nine-phase, 11.5-hour plan for Presheaf/Path.lean: cast kit and sum-form gluing, PathHom/PathCat/BObj with the length functor, the discrete Conduche fibration property of len, the associated presheaf equal to Beh F by rfl, the D = Z clause in two layers (adjacency windows; Quiver.Path equivalence with concatenation), then wiring and the full gate; 52 Challenge-pinned identifiers compiled sorry-bodied at plan time.

memory_candidates.content: For lean4 plans, compile the entire ## Lean Challenge Statements block at plan time with `lake env lean` on a scratch file (sorry bodies, real imports) before writing the plan. It catches signature-level defects that no amount of reading finds: in the Path(F) plan, a bare `def stepQuiver : Quiver F.WorldState` typechecked on its own but Quiver.Path.length/nil/comp then failed instance synthesis; the fix was the Mathlib `Paths V` pattern of a def synonym (`StepGraph F := F.WorldState`) carrying an `instance`, mirroring `PathCat F` for `Category`. Two related constraints on the block: the snapshot tool counts only theorem/lemma/def/instance identifiers (structures and abbrevs must stay out of **Goals**), and any Category/Quiver instance whose hom-set downstream statements depend on definitionally must carry its real `where` body in the block or those statements will not typecheck.
